reason: A server-side dsh web access utility that polyfills crypto.randomUUID and rewrites allowlisted request origins to enable privileged APIs from LAN, tunnel, or other configured hosts; its ability to expose the service and bypass trust checks warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 注入 crypto.randomUUID 兼容实现，并通过白名单主机改写支持局域网、隧道及其他入口访问特权 API。
summaries.en: A server-side dsh Web utility that adds a crypto.randomUUID polyfill and rewrites allowlisted hosts to support privileged API access from LAN, tunnel, and other configured entry points.

capabilities: Injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill into served web pages
Rewrites allowlisted Host and Origin values before browser-trust checks
Enables privileged API access through configured non-loopback hosts
Optionally binds the web server to 0.0.0.0 for LAN access
Provides an optional HTTP and WebSocket tunnel pass-through proxy
Installs and restarts the service through shell commands
